pubbāsava.p: [ pubba + āsava ] (pu) Google Translate The consciousness of past physical pain and perception. (Mahani.) Passion that is focused on the pain of the past.

pubbāsaya.p: [ pubba + āsaya ] (pu) Google Translate Asaya, the location of the land.

R:
pubbāsaya：ပုဗ္ဗာသယ （တိ） （ပုဗ္ဗ+အာသယ）
ရှေးသရကို မှီသော။

pubbasineha：ပုဗ္ဗသိနေဟ （ပ）
ရှေး၌ဖြစ်ဖူးသော ချစ်ခြင်း။
